title: Account Qualification
description: Score any prospect across four dimensions using the FITS framework to decide whether to pursue, nurture, or disqualify.

children.text: Run a prospect through the FITS framework to determine whether to pursue, nurture, or disqualify.

### F, Fit
Does this person match the profile of someone who succeeds with your product or offer?
- Do they have the background or context to get value?
- Is there a mismatch that would set them up to fail?

### I, Intent
How serious are they about moving forward?
- Did they initiate contact, or were they reached out to?
- Are they asking specific questions or vague ones?
- Have they engaged with prior messages?

### T, Timing
Can they realistically start or buy now?
- Do they have scheduling or budget constraints?
- Are there urgency signals (deadline, life event, trigger)?

### S, Situation
Is their current situation compatible with committing?
- Do they have competing priorities or blockers?
- Do they have the support or resources needed to follow through?

Each dimension: 3 (strong), 2 (moderate), 1 (weak).

| Score | Recommendation |
|-------|----------------|
| 10-12 | Pursue actively, high priority |
| 7-9 | Qualified, standard follow-up |
| 4-6 | Nurture, check back in 60-90 days |
| Below 4 | Disqualify, do not invest further |
From `$ARGUMENTS`, extract the prospect information and score each dimension. Explain your reasoning briefly for each score.

```
# Qualification: [Prospect Name or Description]

| Dimension | Score | Reasoning |
|-----------|-------|-----------|
| Fit       | /3    | [why]     |
| Intent    | /3    | [why]     |
| Timing    | /3    | [why]     |
| Situation | /3    | [why]     |
| **Total** | **/12** |         |

## Recommendation
[Pursue / Nurture / Disqualify + one sentence why]

## Next Action
[Specific next step based on score]
```
